title: T006 — invalid output format
purpose: Declaring a target format the engine does not recognize should fail the transform.
trigger: format = "notaformat" in {$target} is not a registered output formatter.
fix: Set {$target} format to a supported value: odin, json, xml, csv, or fixed-width.
notes: An unknown target format is not rejected. The engine currently falls back to JSON-serializing the canonical form and reports success with no errors or warnings; the stable T006 code is not yet emitted.
Use a supported output format to get predictable results.
